notes.title: Policy Changes For Free Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/04e01f130a8599d0f70684fc6a79f864b017f9a3.png[/img]

Greetings from PsychoFlux Entertainment!

We're going to talk about the change of our pricing policy, for most of the free games we're servicing.

We have been servicing a lot of free games by offering main game for free, with an $1 empty DLC for donations; so the users who are satisfied by the game are able to support us and the developers by purchasing the DLC, which also makes the game stay in your Steam library.

However, some of the players told us that the game won't stay in their library even after purchasing the DLC, so they had to visit the store page to install it again. Thus we're going to make some changes to solve this problem and give some advantages to the purchasers.

—

[h1]Steam Edition[/h1]
Free games will be switched to Steam Edition, which will cost about $1. [b]If you already purchased the Donationware DLC, you will automatically receive the Steam Edition of the game.[/b]

Also, games that support a leaderboard will also start to support Steam Leaderboard, so you can upload your score at both of them. Steam Cloud and Steam Achievements will be the same as before. We're planning to update the games that are not supporting these features, so please allow us some time.

And maybe we might add Steam Trading Cards, too!


[h1]New Free Version[/h1]
An alternative free version will be added on Steam to compensate former version. Download button will be displayed on the store page, along with the purchase button for the Steam Edition. This new free version won't support any Steamworks features such as Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Leaderboard, etc.

Achievements that you already unlocked won't go away, but you won't be able to unlock new ones. Your score will only be uploaded on the default leaderboard.


[h1]Donationware DLC[/h1]
These DLCs will be gone from the store. As we mentioned, holder of these DLCs will automatically receive the Steam Edition game.

—

These changes will be applied within a day or two, to the games listed below. Please leave your comments if you have any questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/502130/Ctrl_CV/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/735570/Project_Rhombus/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/739260/Golden_Hornet/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/891130/SUPER_FLAIL/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906390/Return/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978790/Frantic_Dimension/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978800/Rolling_Bird/

notes.title: 1.9.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Added a function to change the controller settings before the game starts.
[*] Slightly modified the control sensitivity.
[list][*] Maximum speed in Interceptor state is reduced
[*] Slightly increased ascent and descent speed in Interceptor mode
[*] Slightly decreased ascent and descent speed in Offender mode
[*] Movement speed decreased when moving forward in both modes[/list][/list]
P.S. Let us know what you think about the control sensitivity changes! Please leave feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/999200/discussions/]forum[/url].

notes.title: 1.9.7 Patch Note
notes.content: Classic control mode has been restored.

notes.title: 1.9.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Classic control mode has been removed.
[*]Option has been added that could adjust the speed of the game.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now when you use [b]Smart Missiles[/b], you will see the number of missiles used in the UI.
[*]From now on, you'll get 100 points for each [b]Infectors[/b] and [b]Infected Offendrons[/b] you kill(was 150 points for each).
[*]Now you'll see the instructions on the title screen if you launched the game for the first time.
[*]Minor bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.4 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the enemy Infectors wouldn't abduct the civilians who have been rescued by you and returned to the ground.

notes.title: 1.9.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]The display method has been changed for 9 or more lives(as shown in the image below).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34102000/057d7a085e6bcd765d8d6481ba3f9f0e162b72de.png[/img]
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies were displayed on the radar when warping.
[*]The 10th Wave is now named Marvelous Minefield.
[*]Now the amount of missiles you have at the beginning of the game is equal to the number of your lives multiplied by 10.
[*]The amount of missiles you get each time you obtain extra lives has been reduced to 10.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Steam's screenshot capture function(F12) didn't work.
[*]Increased the number of the enemy Infectors and reduced the number of other types of enemies on Wave 20 or later.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Modified the conditions for some achievements that were outrageously difficult.
[*]Now the enemy's spawnpoints will be displayed on the radar.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where you couldn't earn some of the Achievements.
[*]The color of the laser that you fired in the Interceptor mode has changed.
[*]The difficulty level of the Traning mode has been adjusted more easily.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now you can practice the game with an easier difficulty in Training mode. Training mode ends when you clear 10th wave.
[*]Fixed an issue where pixels of the icons in the minimap are distorted sometimes.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]New input system for scoreboard has been added, which allows you to record your name by directional keys or controller stick.
[*]Fixed some issues related to enemies' AI.
[*]Now the Quad Case no longer changes its height location randomly.
[*]Now the missiles that you fired when you're in Offender mode will be focused forward.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.1 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed a critical error that occurs in Wave 10.

notes.title: 1.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Hyperspace jump no longer changes the player character's height location.
[*]Enemy TUJATE Space Fighters, Dinkies, and Scatterers' attack pattern has been changed.
[*]Enemy Infectors no longer fires a bullet when it is abducting a civilian.
[*]Several issues related to Steam Achievements has been fixed.
[*]New types of enemy unit has been added: Mothership, EGG, and Enforcer.
[*]New space offense wave, 'Mothership Invasion' has been added.
[*]When you're in Offender mode, you can now fire your laser weapon faster with fewer button presses.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.0 & 1.7.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]1.7.0[/h1]
[list][*]Steam Achievements has been added.[/list]

[h1]1.7.5[/h1]
[list][*]Even more Steam Achievements has been added.
[*]Now the game screen will scroll along the player character when you trigger Hyperspace jump.
[*]Removed the post-delay of Hyperspace jump.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.2 & 1.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]1.6.2[/h1]
[list][*]Now the enemy Infectors that are being tracked by missile cannot inject virus to the civilians.
[*]Fixed an issue where the emeny Dinkies occasionally fired a bullet right after turning.
[*]Enemy Counter-firers' attack radius and fire rate has been reduced.[/list]

[h1]1.6.5[/h1]
[list][*]Improved the game's control sensetivity.
[*]Fixed an issue where rescued civilians would sometimes hung on the weird position.
[*]Now the Glitters would speed up when the player character is nearby.[/list]
